title: A repeatable sample workflow.

title: From a finding to the evidence.
narration: The first finding flags a missing juice statement against a sample company checklist. Read what was observed, compare what was expected, and follow the reference to a concrete next step.
captions: The first finding flags a missing juice statement against a sample company checklist.

title: Show what still needs judgment.
narration: The quantity matches the specification. Printed type size stays open for review, because a digital file alone cannot establish its physical scale.

title: Human judgment stays in the loop.
narration: Acknowledge the finding and keep the decision with the evidence. The original result stays intact. A reviewer action never turns a failed check into a pass.
captions: Acknowledge the finding and keep the decision with the evidence. The original result stays intact.

title: A new version. A fresh review.
